_comment: book-distiller-bot settings. Paths are relative to this folder unless absolute. The model's load profile (context 16384, 2 parallel requests, TTL 600 s) is shared with the other bots and fixed in distiller/llm.py.
_takeover_idle_minutes: another app's model idle this long counts as abandoned and is unloaded; busy ones are waited for
_max_minutes: longest summary the planner may choose (split into 30-minute parts, so at most 4)
_chunk_tokens: max tokens per chapter chunk (bigger chapters split at paragraph breaks); smaller chunks than min are merged with a neighbour
_image_cap: figures kept in the summary; the largest image_candidates are sent to the model for screening
_quote_match_threshold: quotes must fuzzy-match the book at this score (0-100) or they are dropped
_watch_interval: seconds between checks in watch mode
